verdict.rationale: The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec: all candidate paths returned 404. A community source says Viam is built entirely on gRPC with open-source code on GitHub, which implies machine-readable protobuf service definitions may be obtainable. The evidence never explicitly says those definitions can be downloaded. missing for 10: an explicitly documented downloadable spec (OpenAPI or published .proto/buf schemas), first-party docs pointing to it, coverage of cloud/fleet APIs, and hands-on confirmation.
